showGroups.label: Show groups
showGroups.title: Render groups as containers around the concepts and properties that belong to them

erd.label: Show as Entity-Relationship-Diagram
erd.title: Show as Entity-Relationship Diagram — render properties inside concept and metric nodes

changesOnly.label: Changes only
changesOnly.title: Show only the concepts and relationships this change request touches

impactHint.descriptive: Changes how the model reads, not what it means.

summary.add: Does not exist yet. Approving this request creates it.
summary.modify: Approving this request applies the following.

consumers.heading: Breaks on removal
consumers.description: These depend on this concept and do not decide this change. Removing it leaves their references broken.

overlap.heading: Also being changed
overlap.description: Another pending change request edits this element too. Approving this one reshapes the other onto the new state, which usually merges cleanly.

detail.unresolved: This concept does not exist. A relationship in this change request points at it, so the request cannot be applied as it stands.
detail.unresolvedRemovedBy: See the change request that removed it

evidence.heading: Evidence
evidence.none: This change cites nothing. It cannot be checked against a source.
evidence.unresolvable: Cannot be checked again — no repository, path and commit

conflict.removedHereChangedThere: Changed in {{target}} after this proposal removed it
conflict.bothAdded: Also added in {{target}}, with different content
